item.title: Solved: Overcoming the 'No such file or directory quotlimitshquot' Error When Installing Pillow on Alpine Linux
item.description:
When attempting to install the popular imaging library, Pillow, on Alpine Linux running on a Raspberry Pi 2, you might encounter the frustrating error message indicating that the file limits.h is missing. The command you might be using is straightforward:

pip install pillow

Yet, the response from the terminal will be far more complex, detailing multiple instances of this error:

fatal error: limits.h: No such file or directory

What Causes the ’limits.h’ Error?

The limits.h file is part of the standard C library and provides various limits of fundamental integral types. The failure in finding this header typically points to the absence of essential C library files required for compiling packages that contain C extensions, like Pillow. This problem often arises in minimal environments like Alpine Linux, which does not include many of the standard development tools and libraries by default.
